items.text: Tab groups — config tabs are organised as System (General, Theme, Backups, Stats, Keyboard), Dashboard (Pages, Categories, Bookmarks), Extras (Tags, Finders, Collections), and Help. Group labels show which area you are in; the active group is highlighted.
Proportional group width — each group takes space based on how many tabs it contains (e.g. System is wider than Help) instead of four equal columns.

Compact save chrome — slimmer save row with the save-mode pill (Requires save, Auto-save, Read-only) beside Save; Undo and Discard appear only when there are unsaved changes. A subtle divider separates save from tabs; a more tabs → hint appears when the tab bar overflows.
Phone layout — on phones (≤768px), only System and Help groups stay visible; Dashboard and Extras tabs remain available on wider screens.

Fused list surfaces — on Modern and Glass, list tabs (Pages, Categories, Tags, Finders, Collections) now wrap toolbar + list in one .config-tab-surface card, matching Classic instead of showing separate stacked cards.
Unified app chrome — on Modern and Glass, the configuration header, save row, and tab bar read as one connected card with shared borders and a single shadow.

Cross-group tab keys — ←/→ move between tabs and cross into the next group at the edges; Alt+←/Alt+→ jump to the first tab of the previous/next group. Listed on the dashboard cheat sheet and under Config → Keyboard → Config tab bar.
Stronger active tab — clearer active tab and active-group styling (border, inset stripe on Modern/Glass) so the current section is easier to spot.
Compact breadcrumb — breadcrumb shows tab › context (e.g. bookmarks › Work › dev) without a redundant config / prefix.
Config → Help (EN / NL / DE / FR) — What's new recap and General help document tab groups, compact save chrome, Modern/Glass fused surfaces, unified header chrome, and updated keyboard shortcuts.
README, MANUAL, CHANGELOG — release notes for v2026.07.01; Playwright config suite extended for tab groups, proportional widths, and chrome alignment.
